description: Defines the 'Series' class for chart data series in the MigraDoc library, including properties, cloning, serialization, and internal value management.

classes.name: Series
classes.description: Represents a data series in a chart, with properties for data points, formatting, labels, and serialization.

classes.name: Series.SeriesValues
classes.description: Internal nullable values container for the Series class properties.

methods.name: Series.Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the Series object.

methods.name: Series.AddBlank
methods.description: Adds a blank data point to the series.

methods.name: Series.Add
methods.description: Adds a data point with a specific value to the series.

methods.name: Series.Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the Series object into DDL format.
